test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are numbered from 1 to 6. Select the number that will be on the face opposite to the one showing '3'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/27dac92953fb6fbd487e4d5456d04dfa7f2eac5d4449a23994425628da3c764b.png]
solution:
When we compare the figures we get,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/784341592a77102edb1462c3593045cc90c23c88cf6eef6547e630d3cfc5cf77.png] 

We observe that, when we move the dice upwards towards right such that 5 and 1 are visible we find that on the left we have 4 and on right we have 3 which means they both are opposite to each other. So, **4 is the number that will be on the face opposite to the one showing '3'.**

Hence, **"Option 1" **is the correct answer.
